title: Stored liquid hydrogen sold where it lies, at Central Nexus, into the station's bid
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 13:42 UTC (orders.log ENT-014, block APOLLO: sell what stands in storage). One hauler made 75 liquid hydrogen from 200 stored hydrogen gas at the Node Beta workshop (compress_hydrogen_gas, 0 cr, 6.5 min) and sold 42 at Central Nexus at 116 cr (+4,846 cr after fuel, 13:35 to 13:40 UTC); 21 lie at Central Nexus and 12 at Node Beta. The Central Nexus bid stood at 111 x 112 at 12:50 UTC and took 42 at 116 cr at 13:39 UTC. The withdraw step takes what the bid takes at its best price; requires.bid closes the route while a book read within the hour shows under 5 units at 100 cr or more. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
